From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlashealth.com>

Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity — committed term options and start window

Hi Priya,

Quick intro — I'm Maya on AtlasHealth's procurement team. We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated for inference workloads across a few lines of business. Can you share committed-reserved pricing for Dedicated capacity across 12/24/36 month terms, and whether you support staged/tranche activations (we'll likely ramp over multiple quarters)?

Key asks:
- Pricing and discount tiers for 12/24/36 months
- Typical GPU pool sizing recommendations for a 3-region product (US + EU + single APAC) and a mixed 4k/2k sequence workload
- Throughput/SLO guarantees you can commit to (and carve-outs for burst)
- Earliest realistic start date if we sign in mid-May (we prefer a July 1 start)

I've attached our procurement template and approval deadline notes. Can we get a written proposal by end of next week?

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Procurement Manager, AtlasHealth
procurement@atlashealth.com
Attachment: procurement-template.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — committed term options and start window

Maya — thanks for the clear list. High-level we can support 12/24/36 month reserved commits and staged activations. I'm looping Karthik (inference/product) and Ben (sales) to confirm sizing and the commercial structure.

Attached is a pricing sketch and a tranche SOW table that shows a typical split we recommend (can be customized):
- 24-month example: 40% initial active capacity, 30% at Q4, 30% at Q1 next year
- Burst pool: separate smaller pool for 20% short-term bursts (metered) with a surcharge
- SLA: we can guarantee throughput and p95 latency at the tranche level; specifics below after tech parity check

I'll follow up with a consolidated proposal by early next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — sizing and SLA detail

Quick tech notes for the proposal:
- Suggested GPU pool baseline for AtlasHealth profile (mixed 4k/2k seqs, multi-region):
  - US primary: 48 A100-80GB equivalent (serves bulk of traffic)
  - EU standby region: 24 A100-80GB eq (can autoscale for bursts)
  - APAC: 12 A100-80GB eq (lower baseline)
- Throughput guarantee framing (what we commit in contract):
  - Guaranteed concurrent generation capacity expressed as tokens/sec at p95 under steady state for each tranche. Example: Tranche 1 guarantee = 120k tokens/sec aggregate (US), p95 gen latency <= 300ms for 2k seq, <= 520ms for 4k seq.
  - Burst carve-out: up to +25% for 72-hour windows with a surcharge and pre-warmed instances (metered). Bursts beyond that are best-effort fallback to Hosted.
- Ramp behavior: When a tranche activates we'll provision capacity in the target region with a 14-day warm-up; full throughput SLA starts 7 days after activation to allow KV cache warm-up.

I'll include these numbers in the draft SOW. Priya/Ben, if procurement wants stricter warm-up timing we can discuss a short runbook/validation window.

-Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial — discount tiers and payment cadence

Team — for AtlasHealth I recommend we present a clean set of commercial options:
Options (list price assumptions in attached PDF):
- 12-month: baseline price, minimal discount (3–5%)
- 24-month: recommended — 8–12% discount depending on committed GPU-hours and upfront payment
- 36-month: 12–18% discount (larger commit, reserve capacity guarantees)

Suggested payment milestones for staged activation:
- 40% invoice at contract signature (covers initial provisioning and first tranche)
- 30% invoice at tranche 2 activation (go-live acceptance)
- 30% invoice at tranche 3 activation

We should include an option for a 10% holdback tied to final acceptance tests (clears after 30 days of operational metrics). Also propose a capped credit for early termination tied to remaining committed dollars (standard language).

Hannah: can you pull SOC2 evidence and the audit log retention policy for Maya's team to attach?

Thanks,
Ben
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 24-month reserved commit with tranches (recommended)

Maya — attaching a consolidated proposal for AtlasHealth (recommended path: 24-month reserved commit with 3 tranches). Highlights below and attachments include detailed pricing, SOW, and SLAs.

Summary (recommended):
- Term: 24 months (recommended balance of discount and flexibility)
- Tranche schedule and start dates (example):
  - Tranche 1 (40% capacity) — Activation target: 2027-07-01; invoice 40% at signature
  - Tranche 2 (30% capacity) — Activation target: 2027-10-01; invoice 30% at activation
  - Tranche 3 (30% capacity) — Activation target: 2028-01-01; invoice 30% at activation
- Sizing: US 48 GPU eq / EU 24 GPU eq / APAC 12 GPU eq (can adjust after perf run)
- SLA & guarantees: aggregate tokens-per-second guarantees per tranche with p95 latency targets; 7-day post-activation SLA start to allow cache warm-up; 72-hour burst window with metered surcharge (+25% capacity).
- Commercial: 10% list discount for 24-month if customer agrees to proposed payment milestones; 30-day acceptance tests with a 10% holdback that clears after success.

Attachments: Reserved_Commit_Pricing_v2.pdf, SOW-tranche-table.xlsx

Next steps:
- If this aligns, we can issue a redlineable term sheet and send to procurement for signature. Ben will prepare the DocuSign envelope; Hannah will attach SOC2 and audit-retention docs.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
priya@redwood.ai
Attachment: Reserved_Commit_Pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 98KB); SOW-tranche-table.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB)
